wishIKnew: The bus drops you a long way from where the hotels actually are, and the last stretch is a shared auto that fills up slowly. I would have booked the train and arranged a pickup.
bestSurprise: How ordinary it felt by the second morning.
disappointment: The riverside café everyone photographs is five minutes of view and an hour of queue.

wentWrong.what: My bus was two hours late and I arrived after dark with no pickup arranged.
wentWrong.whatIDid: Waited inside the terminal until I could book a cab through the hotel rather than taking one from the rank.
wentWrong.adviceToOthers: Book arrival before 5pm. If you are running late, wait somewhere staffed rather than solving it on the street.

suitableFor: Women looking for a short break

wishIKnew: North and south are two different holidays. I booked north because it is what comes up first, moved south on day two, and wished I had started there.
bestSurprise: Renting a scooter turned the whole trip around. I had been avoiding it for years.
disappointment: Nothing much. The first hotel was on a road with no footpath, which I would not book again.

wishIKnew: That going very early is not only about the crowd. It is quiet, and being there alone at that hour felt completely different from the afternoon.
bestSurprise: Nobody treated a woman on her own as unusual. I had braced for that and it did not come.
disappointment: I booked too close and spent more on the room than I needed to.

wentWrong.what: The hotel had no record of my booking when I arrived.
wentWrong.whatIDid: Showed the confirmation on my phone; they found a room. I had also screenshotted it in case there was no network.
wentWrong.adviceToOthers: Screenshot every confirmation. Do not rely on the email loading when you need it.

suitableFor: Women looking for a short break
